name: Payment Gateway for Ameriabank
author: HK Digital Agency LLC

sections.description:
This plugin connects a WooCommerce store to the vPOS payment service of Ameriabank CJSC, so that customers can pay by card without leaving the shop’s checkout flow.

It is intended for businesses registered in the Republic of Armenia. To use it you need a vPOS agreement with Ameriabank; the bank issues the credentials that the plugin needs.

How a payment works

Once the plugin is configured, Ameriabank appears as a payment method at the checkout. The customer picks it, the shop sends them to the bank’s secure payment page, and the bank returns them to the shop afterwards with the result. No card details ever pass through the shop.

When the customer comes back, the shop asks the bank directly what happened before the order is marked as paid. The payment identifier, the order reference, the amount, the currency and the payment state all have to agree. An order is never marked paid on the strength of the return address alone.

Completed payments can be seen both in the WooCommerce orders screen and in the console Ameriabank provides.

Features

  • Card payments through Visa, Mastercard and ArCa
  • Apple Pay and Google Pay as separate checkout options, each shown only on devices that can use it
  • Saved cards, so returning customers can pay without re-entering their details
  • Cancel a payment within 72 hours, and refund in full or in part, from the order screen
  • Payments in Armenian drams, Russian roubles, US dollars, euros, Swedish kronor and British pounds
  • Two-stage payments, where the amount is held first and captured later
  • Recurring payments with WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • Editable payment method name and description
  • Test mode and a technical log
  • Works with WPML and Polylang: the bank’s page opens in the language the customer is browsing in, and the return, the order page and the e-mails follow the language the order was placed in
  • Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Works with both the classic checkout and the block based checkout

Apple Pay and Google Pay

Both are switched off by default and each has its own checkbox in the settings. Before switching one on, Ameriabank has to enable that functionality for your merchant account.

If you use the bank’s vPOS service, Apple Pay and Google Pay are available to you at no extra charge. You can apply for vPOS through the Online MyBusiness platform: https://ameriabank.am/ameria-business/en/products/acquiring/vpos

No activation key

The plugin needs no identification step and no activation token. Every setting is available as soon as it is activated.

Contacting the bank

For credentials, terms and pricing, contact Ameriabank CJSC on 010 56 11 11 (card and payment infrastructure department) or at vpos.support@ameriabank.am

Requirements

  • A WordPress site with WooCommerce installed
  • A vPOS agreement with Ameriabank CJSC
  • PHP 7.4 or later

Հայերեն

Հավելվածը կապում է WooCommerce խանութը Ամերիաբանկ ՓԲԸ-ի vPOS վճարային համակարգին։ Նախատեսված է ՀՀ տարածքում գործող տնտեսվարող սուբյեկտների համար։ Օգտագործելու համար անհրաժեշտ է vPOS պայմանագիր Ամերիաբանկի հետ, որի շրջանակում բանկը տրամադրում է կարգավորման տվյալները։

Հաճախորդն ընտրում է վճարման եղանակը, կայքն ուղղորդում է նրան բանկի ապահով վճարման էջ, ապա բանկը վերադարձնում է կայք՝ արդյունքի մասին տեղեկացնելով։ Քարտի տվյալները երբեք չեն անցնում խանութի սերվերով։ Պատվերը վճարված է նշվում միայն այն բանից հետո, երբ խանութն ուղիղ հարցնում է բանկին և ստանում հաստատում։

Բանկի vPOS-ից օգտվելու պարագայում Հաճախորդների համար հասանելի են ApplePay և GooglePay ֆունկցիոնալները, արտոնությունը առանց վճարի է, ինչպես նաև Հաճախորդները կարող են vPOS-ի համար դիմել Online MyBusiness հարթակի միջոցով՝ https://ameriabank.am/ameria-business/products/acquiring/vpos

Հավելվածն օգտագործելու համար նույնականացում կամ ակտիվացման բանալի (token) չի պահանջվում։ Տեղադրումից անմիջապես հետո կարգավորումների բոլոր դաշտերը հասանելի են։

Կարգավորման տվյալների, պայմանների և սակագների համար դիմեք Ամերիաբանկ ՓԲԸ՝ 010 56 11 11 հեռախոսահամարով կամ vpos.support@ameriabank.am էլ․ հասցեով։

External services

This plugin connects to the Ameriabank vPOS payment service to register orders, to look up the state of a payment, and to confirm, cancel or refund a payment. The order number, order amount, currency, a short order description and your merchant credentials are sent for each payment. This is required for the gateway to work. Details of the vPOS service, and the form to apply for it, are at https://ameriabank.am/ameria-business/en/products/acquiring/vpos

When the plugin is installed, and again after each update, it sends a one-off notification to https://plugins.hkdigital.am containing four values: the site domain, the plugin version, the e-mail address of the administrator performing the installation, and whether the gateway is switched on. HK Digital uses this to provide support and to notify you about updates. It is sent once per version and never from front-end page loads. No IP addresses are collected, and no customer, order or payment data is sent. HK Digital privacy policy: https://hkdigital.am

  • the availability and security of the user’s website

The plugin is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.

sections.installation:
From the WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins and choose Add New Plugin.
  2. Upload payment-gateway-for-ameriabank.zip and install it.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce, then Settings, then Payments, and open Ameriabank.
  5. Enter the credentials issued by Ameriabank CJSC and save.

By FTP

  1. Upload the payment-gateway-for-ameriabank folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Configure it under WooCommerce, then Settings, then Payments.

After installing

No identification step and no activation token are required. The settings screen is fully available straight away.

Apple Pay and Google Pay each have their own checkbox in the settings and are off by default. Before switching one on, Ameriabank has to enable that functionality for your merchant account, otherwise customers who choose it will be sent to a page that does not open.

The Card page setting is best left as it is unless you have a reason to change it. Not every merchant account accepts a request for a specific page, so test one payment after changing it.

Please note

When the plugin is installed, and again after each update, HK Digital receives the site domain, the plugin version, the e-mail address of the administrator performing the installation, and whether the payment method is switched on. Nothing else is sent. See the External services section.

Տեղադրման և յուրաքանչյուր թարմացման ժամանակ մեր ընկերությանը փոխանցվում են կայքի դոմեյնը, հավելվածի տարբերակը, ադմինիստրատորի էլ-հասցեն և վճարային եղանակի միացված լինելը։ Այլ տվյալներ չեն փոխանցվում։
sections.faq:
Where do I get the credentials?

From Ameriabank CJSC. Call 010 56 11 11 or write to vpos.support@ameriabank.am. You can also apply for the vPOS service online: https://ameriabank.am/ameria-business/en/products/acquiring/vpos

Is my password safe with this plugin?

The plugin never issues, changes or displays your credentials. It stores them in the WooCommerce payment method settings and sends them to the bank only when it registers or looks up a payment. For anything to do with how the credentials are issued and used, and with the bank’s own console and pricing, please contact Ameriabank.

Do I need an activation key or a licence token?

No. Nothing has to be entered to unlock the plugin, and it contacts no licensing service. Install it, activate it, enter the bank’s credentials, and it works.

How do I switch on Apple Pay and Google Pay?

There is a checkbox for each in the payment method settings. Both are off by default.

Ameriabank has to enable the functionality for your merchant account first. If you use the bank’s vPOS service, both are available at no extra charge; you can apply through Online MyBusiness at https://ameriabank.am/ameria-business/en/products/acquiring/vpos

Once switched on, each appears at the checkout as its own payment option, and only on devices that can complete that kind of payment. Apple Pay is shown on Apple devices in Safari; Google Pay elsewhere. Shop managers see both options whatever device they are using, so that the settings can be checked.

Neither can be saved for future payments, so orders that save a card, and subscription renewals, always use the card form.

The shop will not take payments in dollars

Multi-currency payments have to be enabled by the bank for your merchant account. Once the bank has done so, switch on the Multi-currency setting in the payment method and the other currencies become available.

Can I refund or cancel from the orders screen?

Yes. A payment can be cancelled within 72 hours of being made, which reverses it in full. After that, and at any time, you can refund the whole amount or part of it using the Refund button on the order. Choose the option that goes through the payment gateway rather than the manual one, so that the money is actually returned to the customer.

Does it work with a multilingual site?

Yes, with WPML and with Polylang. The bank’s page opens in the language the customer is browsing in, and when they come back the order page and the e-mails use the language the order was placed in. If neither plugin is present, the language chosen in the settings is used.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

Security

  • The payment result is now verified with the bank’s server before an order is marked paid. The payment identifier, the order reference, the amount, the currency and the payment state all have to agree.
  • Closed a hole where changing the order number in the return address could complete an order without payment.
  • Deleting a saved card now requires a signed-in customer and a nonce.

New

  • Apple Pay and Google Pay as separate payment options. Both are off by default and need enabling by the bank for your merchant account. Each is shown only on devices that can use it.
  • WPML and Polylang: the bank’s page opens in the visitor’s language, and the return and the order page follow the language the order was placed in.
  • A Card page setting, for sending customers straight to the card form.
  • Full support for High-Performance Order Storage.
  • The bank’s action code, order identifier, retrieval reference number and payment state are recorded on the order.

Fixed

  • Cancelling an order now actually reaches the bank. The check was made against the order’s already-changed status, so no cancellation request was ever sent.
  • The 72 hour cancellation window was measured with the site’s time zone offset applied to only one side of the comparison.
  • Refunds now report failure instead of setting an invalid order status, and partial refunds are counted correctly.
  • Deleting one saved card left the customer’s remaining cards unreadable.
  • The scheduled check for unfinished payments never ran because of a coding error.
  • Removed a fatal error that could be triggered by any order on the site whose payment gateway is no longer installed.
  • Diagnostic output during a subscription payment was stopping the scheduled task.
  • The description sent to the bank is now plain ASCII; the bank’s page rendered Armenian and Cyrillic as question marks.
  • Added the response codes that were missing from the error table, in all three languages.
  • When the shop cannot reach the bank, the reason is written to the log and to the order notes.
  • Everything the plugin adds is now declared at the moment WooCommerce asks for it, so the payment options cannot be left out of the checkout by another plugin loading first.

Other

  • Removed the identification screen and the activation token. Every setting is available immediately.
  • Updated for WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 11.0.
  • Passed the WordPress Coding Standards security checks.
  • Updated the card scheme logos.
  • Added a link to Ameria MyBusiness on the settings screen, for merchants who still need to apply for the vPOS service.
  • Fixed the help tips on the settings screen, whose images never appeared because of a wrong character in a selector.
  • The Card page setting is no longer greyed out when a wallet option is switched on; it applies in both cases.
